title: Shipped seed produces overlapping node hitboxes, contradicting the spec's 'separation floor keeps hitboxes disjoint'
evidence: scripts/world_seed.gd:26 `const MIN_NODE_SEPARATION_RAD := 0.25 # keeps node hitboxes (r 0.95) from overlapping` | scripts/world_seed.gd:148-150 `var sep := MAXF_SEPARATION_FLOOR * (1.0 - float(attempt) / 80.0) * MIN_NODE_SEPARATION_RAD` / `if sep < MIN_NODE_SEPARATION_RAD * 0.25:` / `sep = MIN_NODE_SEPARATION_RAD * 0.25` | scripts/node_site.gd:28 `sphere.radius = 0.95` | spec-e1-tiny-planet.md:127 `- 33 connectables (6 routers + 27 houses), separation floor keeps hitboxes disjoint` | probe run on the reviewed state (SEED=20260904): `min pairwise surface distance (R=8): 0.67820475392952` / `closest pair: ["n25", "n30"]` / `overlap? true`
detail: The 0.25-rad floor decays to 25% under placement pressure, so the disjointness claim is false: n25/n30 sit 0.678 units apart against a 1.9-unit hitbox diameter. Buildings interpenetrate in committed captures 02/03 (bottom-left), and a press in the overlap can grab the wrong node.
recommended_fix: Make the 0.25-rad separation non-decaying (reseed or widen inset if placement fails), or shrink the hitbox radius, so pairwise surface distance stays >=1.9 units; regenerate captures.

title: Spec declares status 'done' but the A3 Godot-MCP verification loop task is still unchecked
evidence: spec-e1-tiny-planet.md:5 `status: 'done'` | spec-e1-tiny-planet.md:84 `- [ ] Godot MCP loop: 'lsp-diagnostics' clean on all GDScript; 'editor-run' + 'debug-output' boot check, iterate on errors -- A3`
detail: Briefing A3 is 'verified, not claimed' via the Godot MCP, yet the deliverable's own tracker leaves that loop unchecked while declaring done. Import, headless suite, and a windowed capture boot ran clean in review, but MCP lsp-diagnostics evidence (zero warnings) is not demonstrated.
recommended_fix: Run Godot MCP lsp-diagnostics over all scripts plus an editor-run/debug-output boot check, record the results, and check the box (or downgrade status until done).

title: 33 staged nodes contradict the GDD's 'MVP node count 4-6'; the cited 'bigger planet, many buildings' direction exists only in the implementer's own spec
evidence: gdd.md:327 `| Planet — MVP node count | 4–6 | '[FORGE MVP — inherited]' |` | scripts/world_seed.gd:123 `# 2 routers + 9 houses per wedge — a world with MANY connectables.` | spec-e1-tiny-planet.md:121 `- One seed drives everything; R=8 after the "bigger planet, many buildings" direction`
detail: The slice stages 33 nodes (test asserts 33) against the GDD numeric design's 'MVP node count 4-6'. The only justification appears in the implementer's own spec file, absent from the briefing and epic, so scope drift cannot be ruled out from the reviewed inputs.
recommended_fix: Confirm the node-count direction with the user and log it in the decision log; otherwise reduce placement to the GDD's 4-6 MVP node count.
